name: 康复动作负荷估算（体重 · 次数 · 组数 · 周频）

map.按体重、每组次数、组数与每周天数估算康复动作负荷，并给出每周 +10% 的渐进参: Estimate rehab exercise load from body weight, reps, sets and weekly frequency, with a 10% weekly progression guide and a pain-score safety check.
map.负荷按“体重×次数×组数”做算术估算，周负荷为单次负荷乘以每周天数；渐进参考只加: Load is an arithmetic estimate of body weight × reps × sets; weekly load multiplies the session load by days per week; progression adds only 10% and does not replace a rehab prescription. The pain score is a safety gate: above 3/10 or worse next day, reduce the load first.
map.负荷为算术估算（体重×次数×组数），不是康复处方；术后、急性损伤或疼痛持续加重请: Load is an arithmetic estimate (body weight × reps × sets), not a rehab prescription; after surgery, acute injury or worsening pain, have a rehab clinician or therapist assess it.
map.按体重、每组次数、组数与每周天数估算单次/每周负荷。: Estimate per-session and weekly load from body weight, reps per set, sets and days per week.
map.术后或伤后康复训练中，用疼痛评分与 +10% 周增量控制进阶，避免加量过快。: In post-surgical or post-injury rehab, use pain scores and a +10% weekly increment to control progression and avoid ramping up too fast.
map.体重 70kg、每组 12 次、3 组、每周 3 天 → 单次负荷 2520 k: Body weight 70 kg, 12 reps per set, 3 sets, 3 days per week → per-session load 2520 kg·reps, weekly load 7560 kg·reps; next week's +10% reference is 2772 per session and 8316 per week; with a pain score of 0 the load can be maintained.
map.疼痛评分怎么用？: How should the pain score be used?
map.每周加多少合适？: How much should be added each week?
map.本页只给 +10% 的算术参考，不替代康复处方；实际进阶应结合疼痛、肿胀与治疗师: This page only provides an arithmetic +10% reference and does not replace a rehabilitation prescription; actual progression should consider pain, swelling and the therapist's advice.

This page does the load arithmetic only — it does not prescribe exercises, does not track adherence and does not replace a rehabilitation plan.

map.单次负荷(kg·次) = 体重 × 每组次数 × 组数；周负荷 = 单次负荷 ×: Single-session load (kg·reps) = body weight × reps per set × sets; weekly load = single-session load × training days per week; next-week reference = weekly load × 1.1 (+10%); time per set ≈ reps per set × 3 seconds. Pain score 0-10: above 3 prompts a reduction or pause and a consultation with a rehab physician.
map.💡 单次负荷 = 体重 × 每组次数 × 组数；周负荷 = 单次 × 每周天数；: 💡 Single-session load = body weight × reps per set × sets; weekly load = single-session × days per week; next-week reference +10%. If pain score > 3/10 or worsens the next day, reduce the load first and consult a rehab physician.
map.动作中或次日疼痛 >3/10 时先降负荷或暂停；评分只是安全提示，持续疼痛需康复: If pain during the movement or the next day is > 3/10, reduce the load or pause; the score is only a safety hint, and persistent pain needs assessment by a rehab physician.
